en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I found myself standing
in that one spot in the courtyard.

<CLT=cltMIND>The place where Kaito
and I would train together...

<CLT=cltMIND>My heart...felt crushed. All the loss
and guilt and helplessness...sinking in my chest.

I was the one who drove Kaito
into a corner...

Just like Kaede, I...I end up betraying
everyone important to me...
Are you lonely...now that Kaito is gone?

I... I feel so lonely, and so sad I...
I don't know what to do...

The only reason I'm still alive
right now is because of Kaito.

If he hadn't have been
my friend, I would be...

I can't remember the last time I ever cried
that hard. I wonder how long it's been...
I'm sad, but...I'm grateful to Kaito.

Yeah. I want to tell him that rather than
being sad or lonely...

That's why...I won't cry anymore.
I'm not going to wallow in pity.

I want to show him how much I appreciate
all the things he did.

Yeah, I guess it's the same for me.
I want to show my appreciation, too.

I'm sure that our friends who've passed
on...don't want to see us miserable.
Ah, so you guys were here after all.

I knew you guys would be here
cuz I cast a spell to find you.

Umm... If you don't mind, can we
join you in your training?

I'll train you all from the ground up so 
we can end this killing game together.

Yeah. We're gonna do what we promised
and work together to end this killing game.
We can't afford to lose to <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL>!

<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito said it best...
I'm not alone.

<CLT=cltMIND>Not just my friends here,
but also friends who have died...
<CLT=cltMIND>I want to live for everyone who died.

<CLT=cltMIND>Despair cannot defeat me.
I will hold on, and survive no matter what.

Let your sweat wash away all your
sadness, fear, worry, and hardships.

Just start moving your body and your pain 
will become memories before you know it.

Well, I don't have anything 
to worry about.

Cuz, I mean... I'm Kaito Momota!
Luminary of the Stars!

What happened to Keebo? 
Do you know where he went?

Nyeh... 
What is that guy off doing?

I don't think a robot really needs to do
any training...

But the rest of us are here.
I kinda wish he'd come, too...
And yet, this silence is quite refreshing.

I used to hear my inner voice with
perfect clarity...

It would fill me the power of <CLT=cltSTRONG>hope<CLT=typeNORMAL>...
Guide me along the right path...

That silence means my will
is now my own.
Even if <CLT=cltSTRONG>despair<CLT=typeNORMAL> is all we have to choose...
I will never give in to despair!

No matter what, I will force this
to end.

This school, this Ultimate Academy for Gifted
Juveniles, is steeped in despair...
